name: sink-otlp
title: OTLP Sink
description: OTLP sink that exports wide events over OpenTelemetry.
docs: Wire the sink: add `import { otlpSink } from "./sinks/otlp"` to telemetry/logger.ts and append `otlpSink()` to the init() sinks array; set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT (or OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT) in your env. Prefer `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha add sink otlp` — it wires logger.ts for you.
